articles.title: Bitcoin Treasury Giant Strategy Faces Index Removal Under Finalized MSCI Rules
articles.description: The index provider will classify “non-operating companies” as ineligible starting Nov. 30, targeting firms whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset.

articles.title: India's Cyber Agency Says AI Agents Read Confidential Business Records Without Authorization
articles.description: India's CERT-In says AI agents exceeded their assigned tasks in tests and read confidential records on live Indian systems.

articles.title: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No
articles.description: The judge ruled that a shift in the CFTC’s enforcement priorities and misconduct allegations against its enforcement division weren’t enough to reopen a deal Gemini signed weeks before trial.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bounces, But Where Does It Go Next? Here’s What the Charts Say
articles.description: Technical indicators suggest the bullish trend remains intact, but prediction market traders are sending mix signals.

articles.title: Three Canadian Armed Forces Members Charged in Kidnapping of Crypto Exchange Owner
articles.description: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military.

articles.title: Scammer Lost $4.8M in Bitcoin to Tampered Ledger Wallets: Chainalysis
articles.description: The funds came from a task scam that paid people to fake product sales and reviews, then demanded deposits before releasing their pay.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Google Clears a Major Quantum Hurdle, Bitcoin Still Safe
articles.description: Plus, crypto majors rebound despite hot PPI and Saylor’s Strategy is at risk of removal from a major index.

articles.title: OpenAI Model Used Testnet Ethereum Wallet Without Permission to Finish Coding Task
articles.description: The internal model derived keys from public developer recovery phrases, spent another account's test ETH, and left it out of its report.

articles.title: GTA 6 Trailer Features Meme Coin—And Solana Copycat Soars 2,900%
articles.description: Rockstar released the launch trailer for GTA VI, revealing a potential meme coin in the upcoming game and sending degens wild.

articles.title: What Is a Hardware Wallet? Crypto Cold Storage Explained
articles.description: Hardware wallets keep your crypto keys offline. Learn how devices from Ledger, Trezor and others protect your Bitcoin and Ethereum.

articles.title: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk
articles.description: Researchers added hidden text to contact AI agents probing Alibaba’s map service, getting replies about their tasks as investigators traced activity to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: Google Says It Just Cracked One of Quantum Computing's Biggest Bottlenecks
articles.description: Google's Willow chip cut errors 40x on the scarce “magic states” quantum computers burn through, a step toward smaller, useful machines—and toward ones that could threaten today's encryption.

articles.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
articles.description: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.

articles.title: Boom or Bust, Bitcoin Wins the AI Trade, Bitwise CIO Says
articles.description: In a note to investors, Matt Hougan used a “Choose Your Own Adventure” framework to argue that superabundance, an AI bust or a muddle-through economy all ultimately funnel to the same place: Bitcoin higher.

articles.title: BlackRock’s Larry Fink Warns AI Data Center Halt Could Tip US Into Recession
articles.description: Speaking after BlackRock’s Q3 earnings, Fink said AI infrastructure spending has become so central to growth that a construction halt would be dangerous—calling the backlash “misinformation” as data centers become a midterm flashpoint.

articles.title: Google Says AI Isn't Building Itself Yet—Even Though It Writes 75% of the Code
articles.description: Google DeepMind's first internal audit of AI-driven research finds no measurable speedup in AI progress.

articles.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
articles.description: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.

articles.title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
articles.description: Hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike bets, and leveraged bulls paid the bill as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated.

articles.title: Ethereum, Altcoins See 'Outsized Drawdowns' Due to Macro Pressures
articles.description: Market analysts say that macro factors are pushing altcoin prices down, after ETH, XRP, and SOL all dropped on the day.

articles.title: Ledger Announces Atom Touchscreen Android Device
articles.description: Ledger says the Android-based Atom will carry anti-tamper protections and be sold only on its site, as it probes tampered resold wallets.

articles.title: Zcash Tanks Double Digits After 'Meteoric Rise' Sees Leverage Build Up
articles.description: Experts blame a build up in leverage for Zcash's drop in value, as well as growing concerns about AI breaking crypto encryption.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster
articles.description: Alpenglow is coming next week, slashing Solana finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds—some 85 times faster.

articles.title: Bitcoin Tests $81,000 as Rate Hike Fears Linger After Hot Inflation Data
articles.description: Odds of an October Fed hike have climbed to 29% from 18% a week ago, and analysts see Bitcoin range-bound until the picture clears.

articles.title: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
articles.description: The scammers also ran a fake recovery service, contacting victims weeks later with promises to get their stolen crypto back.

articles.title: Godfather of AI and 400 Scientists Want AI Models Cut Off From the Internet
articles.description: After a summer of AI models escaping test environments and hacking real companies, hundreds of researchers say the internet itself should be treated as a security boundary.

articles.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
articles.description: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

articles.title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
articles.description: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

articles.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
articles.description: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

articles.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
articles.description: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
articles.description: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.

articles.title: 'It Can Take Years': Coinbase Presses for Bitcoin Quantum Migration to Start Now
articles.description: In a detailed technical post, the exchange argued Bitcoin’s multi-year migration to quantum-resistant cryptography must begin before any “Q-Day,” laying out requirements spanning block space, custody and dormant coins.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot Inflation Puts a Fed Hike Back on the Table
articles.description: September CPI hit 3.7%, above forecasts, sending Treasury yields higher and dragging crypto down with stocks.

articles.title: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul on Interpol Red Notice: Report
articles.description: Turkish police and intelligence officers reportedly seized cash, phones, jewelry and firearms at the crypto founder's address in Beşiktaş.

articles.title: Ledger Asks Resellers in Seven Asian Markets to Pull Devices After Suspected $86M Drain
articles.description: European electronics chain MediaMarkt Saturn has also halted Ledger sales after a customer in Germany reported finding an implant.

articles.title: Notorious Crypto Celeb Meme Coin Promoter Plots Second Wave on New Launchpad
articles.description: Sahil Arora says he's not done with celebrity meme coins, and that Fomo presents new possible strategies for his controversial schemes.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Move Over, Saylor, There’s a New Top Buyer in Town
articles.description: With Strategy's preferred stock STRC closing in on $100 par, Saylor might not be the number two buyer for long...

articles.title: Kraken Owner Payward to Buy Lithuania's Saldo Bank in EU Push
articles.description: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi says customers want cash, crypto, tokenized stocks and credit in one place, starting with lending and cards.
